entities.name: Trévor Clévenot
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Trévor Gérard Jean-Claude Clévenot is a French professional volleyball player who plays as an outside hitter for Ziraat Bankası Ankara and the France national team. Clévenot won a gold medal in the men's tournament at the Olympic Games Tokyo 2020 and is a two–time World League winner.
